description: Searches the DIY Accounting Submit guide (its how-to journeys and the MCP, rates and MTD calendar pages) and the diya-gl knowledge base for a question, and answers each match's title, a two-line summary and its public address, best match first. Use this when the person asks how to do something on DIY Accounting Submit, what a step of a filing involves, or a bookkeeping or tax question the knowledge base explains, and give them the address to read. It needs no DIYA-GL book, does not read the person's records, and gives no advice on their own case.

limit.description: How many matches to answer, 1 to 10; 5 when omitted

query.description: The question or the words to search for, as the person put it

source.description: Search only the Submit guide (guide) or only the diya-gl knowledge base (knowledge-base)

name: find_help
title: Find help
